scientific_integrity: Exact multiplication and rank-one rigidity proof; integer arithmetic verifier supplements rather than replaces all-order proof. No independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the complex coefficient field and odd finite abelian core quandles. Quandle automorphisms are distinguished from full algebra automorphisms. No claim about integral automorphism groups, even orders, nonabelian cores, or modular coefficients. Prior Fourier techniques acknowledged; novelty subject to incomplete/unindexed literature.
title: Fourier-monomial automorphisms of complex odd core-quandle algebras
